study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 872 women delivering at or after 37 weeks gestation
finding: Early term infants were significantly less likely to be exclusively breastfed compared to full-term infants, despite comparable breastfeeding initiation frequencies.
mod_finding: While early-term delivery was not associated with a difference in breastfeeding initiation, it was associated with significantly lower odds of exclusive breastfeeding compared to full-term infants.
